data.exact_reserve_text: In 2021, there has been an overall deterioration of GBP 2,626k on prior year reserves (2020: deficit GBP 11,576k).

named_events.event_name: Russia instigated military action in Ukraine
named_events.loss_description: This event is still developing as at the date of the Financial Statements, but has been assessed by the Directors as an event that will increase risk and uncertainty globally in the foreseeable future.

data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate reported an overall deterioration of 3.549 million USD on prior year reserves in 2021, representing a 2.03% strengthening relative to the opening gross claims outstanding. This adverse development is attributed to general factors such as economic and claims cost inflation, regulatory changes, court rulings, and other estimation uncertainties. No specific events were named as direct causes for this deterioration. The 2019 and prior underwriting years were externally reinsured to close at year-end 2021.
raw_causal_phrases: overall deterioration of GBP 2,626k on prior year reserves
claim numbers for each underwriting year
changes in market factors such as public attitude to claiming
data.data_quality_notes: The opening reserves figure is the 2020 closing balance of Claims outstanding from the Statement of Financial Position. The prior year development amount is explicitly stated in GBP in the narrative and has been converted to USD using the 2021 year-end exchange rate of 0.74 USD:GBP. The claims development triangle on page 16, when analyzed for prior year development (excluding the two most recent underwriting years), suggests a release of -8.013m USD, which contradicts the explicit narrative of a deterioration. The explicit narrative statement is taken as primary. The report mentions an RITC for 2019 and prior underwriting years, which could affect how prior year reserves are presented or developed, but the narrative figure is used as the direct statement of re-estimation.
